The app automatically checks if there’s an available firmware and, if the user confirms, it proceeds with the update.

Tips / troubleshooting:

- Be sure that the trainer is powered and the blue led is blinking.
- Keep the device close to the trainer to improve the transmission
- Close the all the app using Bluetooth in background (my E-training, Zwift, TrainerRoad, The Sufferfest, etc…)
- If you have problem in the connection, try rebooting the phone/tablet and the trainer. If this doesn’t fix the problem, contact us at myetraining@elite-it.com

Forebet - Mathematical football predictions, stats and scores, AI, covering most football leagues from all around the world. 

Forebet in its core is a Predictive analytics tool, which uses Artificial Intelligence techniques to analyse past football data and calculate probabilities for future outcomes. 
It’s main goals are to deliver statistical insight by identifying patterns and trends in the enormous football data, to be easy to use,  to provide reliable and fast live score service and present in comprehensible manner the football statistical data. 

The Forebet key features include:

PREDICTIONS - A system for predicting football matches on the basis of statistics using complex mathematical algorithms. Probabilities are calculated for the final outcome of the match, goals scored, etc. The Forebet machine learning algorithms work on a huge database storing football data generated since year 2000. The results are then displayed in the app clearly in an easy to understand way.

STATISTICS - User friendly displayed statistical data for each match such as league standings, team form, last played matches results, head to head statistics between the match opponents, overall accumulated stats such as average scored or conceded goals, next matches opponents difficulty level calculated by an algorithm, which analyses the teams past performance.

LIVE SCORES - updating the matches scores while they are in-play with their interesting events by minute such as goalscorers, assist players, yellow or red cards, substitutions.

TRENDS - Standout statistical trends outlined and formed in a human readable text.

PREVIEWS - Unique match previews for some of the most interesting upcoming matches, created by our experienced editorial team.

FAVOURITES - Follow the matches that matter to you simply by tapping on the star button next to each prediction row or just follow an entire league by selecting it from the leagues menu as a favourite again by the star button.

ABOUT FOREBET
Forebet has been using AI techniques and delivering its mathematical football predictions since 2009 when the first statistical model was created an uploaded online. Since then our team always worked passionately to improve and develop the system.
Forebet is and has always been free, delivering unique content to the football fans!

GeoTracker Lite is a free lightweight GPS Tracking/Recording App with many useful features:

- Records your location, speed, altitude, acceleration, g-force (if available), atmospheric pressure (if available) and device inclination (if available)
- Plays recorded tracks at 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x and 16x speeds
- Get suggested routes/directions and use them as reference paths for your current activity
- Exports recorded track data to XLSX Spreadsheets and GPX files
- Create PDF Reports with track details and charts
- Import tracks from other users and from GPX files
- View recorded track details: Distance Travelled, Moving duration, Avg/Max Speeds, Min/Max Acceleration, Min/Max Slope and more
- Time charts: Distance, Speed, Altitude, Acceleration, G-Force (if available), Inclination (if available), Pressure (if available)
- Customize Distance, Speed, Acceleration, Altitude and Pressure units

Important 1: This version of GeoTracker can record up to 10 minutes or 10 kilometers per track, whichever comes first.

Important 2: GeoTracker Lite does not require any profile registration and does not contain any advertising.
